response.overview: The expectations he imagined about his new dormitory residents were the same as those in his old dormitory—friendly and kind. However, reality turns out to be the exact opposite of his hopes. Will everything slowly change for the better, or will it instead get worse?  Release Note: This digital film is released periodically on the official YouTube channel 'H FILMS', divided into three parts (Act 1, Act 2, and Act 3).
response.title: BACK N REPLAY
